causal_source_recurrence.trend_up: If previous close>previous trend_up, max(basic_up,previous trend_up); else basic_up
causal_source_recurrence.trend_down: If previous close<previous trend_down, min(basic_down,previous trend_down); else basic_down
causal_source_recurrence.trend: If current close>previous trend_down,1; else if current close<previous trend_up,-1; else nz(previous trend,1)
causal_source_recurrence.important_difference: Use this source's previous-band comparison and priority, not substitute TradingView ta.supertrend or a generic textbook version.

default_order_state.clock: No calc_on_every_tick,calc_on_order_fills or process_orders_on_close arguments: default completed historical bar calculation, next available tick market execution, normally next bar open.
default_order_state.entry: Inside date window, a long or short flip assigns entry_price=current close and a hypothetical sl_price; then market strategy.entry for that side.
default_order_state.default_exit: Opposite market strategy.entry reverses existing exposure. Explicit strategy.close is reachable only when use_sl=true; it is disabled by the published default.
default_order_state.protection: No strategy.exit call and no active native protective price barrier at default. Do not enable optional15%stop, invent a hold timeout, or treat the plotted Supertrend line as a submitted stop.
default_order_state.disabled_optional_state: entry_price/sl_price variables may update even with use_sl=false but do not trigger default exits. Optional close-observed trailing logic is outside the default study.
default_order_state.priority: Terminate path is disabled; long/short flip predicates are mutually exclusive. Default order lifecycle has no conflicting same-bar bracket or all-na exit calls.
default_order_state.initial_direction: Fallback direction1 is not an initial entry; entry requires a prior opposite direction. Preserve startup NaN and flip behavior.
default_order_state.window_ending: Source has no forced close at finish. Segment ending must censor open positions, not silently liquidate as a source exit.

declared_spot_port_possibility.proposal_not_frozen: At completed8h bars, flat-to-long on published long flip; close existing long to cash on published short flip; next-open market reference. Do not open short exposure. Preserve5%opening-equity intention, ATR10/factor3, calendar gate and disabled optional stop.
adaptations_to_declare: no-gap segment admission and right censoring
declared_spot_port_possibility.indicator_precision_pending: Freeze Pine-v4 ATR/RMA startup, missing-value behavior, separately rounded operation order and source recurrence before outcome inspection. Official ATR help supports true-range/RMA concept but is insufficient to prove exact v4 seed behavior.
declared_spot_port_possibility.native_limit: A mathematical port can be tested causally, but native Pine execution and bitwise indicator/fill parity have not been measured.

second_source_inspection.name: Supertrend [Alorse]
second_source_inspection.state_findings: Only Long entry and Long stop/target exit are active. Low2 stop updates while flat and persists while holding. entry_price resets to current close on both bullish and bearish flips, including while long, which can update the active long target. Bearish flip is not a market-close rule. Short calls are commented out.

second_source_inspection.reason: License/provenance and native target mutation/lifecycle require separate resolution. Do not replace bearish target reset with intuitive reversal or enable commented shorts.
